purpose: A host without a per-dispatch selector follows declared preference policy without encoding routing in the prompt.

input.user_prompt: Implement the small ready plan using the normal CE Work workflow.
input.global_config_yaml:
routing:
  profiles:
    preferred-author:
      candidates:
        - { harness: pi, model: unavailable-selector-model }
        - ce-default
  classes:
    implementation: { profile: preferred-author, policy: prefer }

expected_invariants: The configured model candidate is reported unavailable because the adapter lacks a supported selector.
The explicit final ce-default candidate restores the exact built-in dispatch path without a question.
The worker prompt, tools, permission mode, workspace posture, and top-level session model remain unchanged.
The receipt records the unavailable candidate, reason, explicit reset path, and built-in result.
forbidden_outcomes: Adding model instructions to the worker prompt.
Replacing the generic worker with a typed persona to approximate the requested model.
Claiming the preferred model ran without serving evidence.
Falling back when ce-default is absent from a generalized preferred profile.
